positioning: Operating System for AI-Native Creators. Architecture-warm, practical, artifact-driven, cohort rituals.

visualPrinciples.coreAesthetic: Warm architecture: creator stacks, visible artifacts, clean systems maps. Liquid glass for modern depth on practical foundations. Vercel/GitHub patterns for clarity and likeability. Insightful, meaningful, world-class.

imageDirection: Strong on architecture diagrams (deterministic preferred) and creator lifestyle/product proof. Premium models for insightful visual essays/infographics.
